notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
description:
Cast Explosive Welcome by paying {7}{R}, targeting any two targets.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Explosive Welcome, targeting any two targets.
Resolve the copy of Explosive Welcome, adding {R}{R}{R}, dealing three damage to any target and dealing five damage to any other target.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
